entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? I'll give you a preference! I prefer not to have massive blisters on my heels after one ride! These things are torture devices, not shoes. The cleats never felt secure either. I'm done with them.
I see. I can definitely appreciate your frustration with getting blisters, that's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information.

You do that. And you better have a solution for me, because I want a full refund. If I don't get it, I'm lighting up every review site and social media platform with pictures of my feet. This is ridiculous. Get me your manager!

There's no need to speak with a manager, sir, I can handle this for you directly. I've just located your order. It looks like you received the shoes 57 days ago. I can confirm that your item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Oh. So you're actually going to do something? It's within 10 days, you say?
Yes, absolutely. We can process a return for a full refund right away. I've just initiated the process and sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address we have on file for you.
Fine. About time. So a label is coming to my email?

That's correct. Just print it out, package the shoes in their original box, and drop it at any post office. As soon as our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
